lists.name: RYM Top — Scenes & Movements — CBGB Scene

podcast.body: Johnny Thunders, a New York punk pioneer, included an instrumental surf track called "Pipeline" (originally by The Chantays from 1962) on his debut album. "His debut album features an instrumental entitled Pipeline, a surf track from the Shantays from 1962."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Surprising History of Surf Music
